THE NEIGHBORING TENANTS HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED BUT CHOSE TO STAY. THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT WILL REMAIN ON-SCENE AND CONDUCT A FIRE WATCH UNTIL THE EPA ARRIVES TOMORROW.

properties.title: NRC Report: Oil: Diesel in Bass River near New Gretna, NJ
properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 882059 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: VIKING YACHT COMPANY
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 882059
Incident Time: 2008-08-27 19:00:00
Nearest City: New Gretna, NJ
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: VIKING YACHT COMPANY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 2 gallons
WHILE TRANSFERRING FUEL FROM ONE ONBOARD TANK TO THE OTHER ON A VESSEL, THE RECEIVING TANK WAS OVERFILLED. PERSONNEL WERE MONITORING THE TRANSFER AND WERE ABLE TO SHUT THE PUMP OFF IMMEDIATELY WHEN DIESEL FUEL CAME OUT OF THE FUEL FILL AND VENT. THE FUEL VENT HAD A 1 GALLON CONTAINMENT CONTAINER ATTACHED THAT COLLECTED ABOUT ONE HALF GALLON, SO THE SPILL WAS LIMITED TO ABOUT 1.5 GALLONS. THE SPILLED QUANTITY WAS CALCULATED BY 12 GAM TRANSFER RATE FOR 10 SECONDS BEFORE PUMPING AND PRESSURE STOPPED (12GPM X .17 MINUTES = 2.04 GALLONS, LESS THE HALF GALLON CONTAINED IN THE OVERFILL CONTAINER AT THE VENT RESULTS IN A 1.5 GALLON SPILL. A CONTAINMENT BOOM WAS ALREADY IN PLACE, AS SECONDARY CONTAINMENT, AT THE END OF THE LIFT WELL WHILE THE FUEL TANKS WERE BEING FILLED. IMMEDIATELY, ADDITIONAL BOOMS AND ABSORBANT PADS WERE PLACED TO ABSORB THE FUEL. ALL FUEL WAS ABSORBED AND CLEANED UP WITHIN 2 HOURS. THE FLUE WAS CONTAINED AND NO FUEL LEFT THE TRAVEL LIFT WELL.

Medium Affected: LAND

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.814103, -75.524176 (Approximated from route)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** AT THE BOTTOM OF THE SKI AREA, NEAR THE PUMP HOUSE AND WATER RESERVOIR, THERE IS A DIESEL TANKER TRUCK THAT IS LEAKING DIESEL FUEL INTO THE GROUND FOR A LONG TIME. THE COMPANY KNOWS ABOUT THE LEAK BUT THEY CONTINUE TO FILL AND LEAVE IT THERE TO CONTAMINATE THE GROUND AND POSSIBLY THE WATER SUPPLY. A CONTAINER WAS PLACED UNDER THE LEAK BUT IT IS NOT VERY EFFECTIVE. AT THE VALLEY ENTRANCE TO THE SKI AREA, BEHIND THE TUBING LANES, THERE IS AN ACCESS ROAD TO THE PUMP HOUSE. THE OLDER MODEL BLUE FUEL TRUCK IS ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE PUMP HOUSE. IT IS LESS THAN 500 YARDS FROM A BODY OF WATER AND THE SKI SLOPE. THE FUEL RUNS DOWNHILL.
